_comment: How an inflicted sandfall climbs the tiers, dial by dial (design 5.2.2).
Difficulty rather than a verdict: you can roof over sand, and the burial hands you the glass to do it
with. So the nuisance unsettles and the damage is a hazard, as the deluge's and the meteors' are:
`often` (how often one comes, and how many may stand at once) and `long` (how long one lives) unsettle
until their far end; `size` (how wide it grows, up to twenty by twenty) and `depth` (how deep a pass
